# telnyx_voice_design (Resource)

A voice design, a synthetic voice generated from a description and a sample text.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `prompt` (String) Natural language prompt used to define the voice style for this version.
- `text` (String) Sample text used to synthesize this version.

### Optional

- `language` (String) Language for synthesis. Supported values: Auto, Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian. Defaults to Auto. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `max_new_tokens` (Number) Maximum number of tokens to generate. Default: 2048. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `name` (String) Name of the voice design.
- `repetition_penalty` (Number) Repetition penalty to reduce repeated patterns in generated audio. Default: 1.05. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `temperature` (Number) Sampling temperature controlling randomness. Higher values produce more varied output. Default: 0.9. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `top_k` (Number) Top-k sampling parameter — limits the token vocabulary considered at each step. Default: 50. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `top_p` (Number) Top-p (nucleus) sampling parameter — cumulative probability cutoff for token selection. Default: 1.0. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `voice_provider` (String) Voice synthesis provider used for this design. One of `Minimax`, `Telnyx`, `minimax`, `telnyx`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the voice design was first created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the voice design.
- `provider_supported_models` (List of String) List of TTS model identifiers supported by this design's provider (e.g. `Qwen3TTS`, `speech-02-turbo`).
- `provider_voice_id` (String) Provider-specific voice identifier. For Telnyx designs this is the design version ID; for Minimax it is the Minimax-assigned voice ID.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the resource type.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the voice design was last updated.
- `version` (Number) Version number of this voice design.
- `version_created_at` (String) Timestamp when this specific version was created.
- `voice_sample_size` (Number) Size of the voice sample audio in bytes.
